rows: How many times do we have to be ready before someone lets us begin?
Brawling is a question nobody asks properly. Who decides when the fight starts?
A risk is a question with a price on it. Who pays it?
Pace is a question of who is allowed to set it. Are you letting me?
The people are asking the same question I am. Will this be a real contest?
Quick version: I have been asking for a fair start for a while, and I am still asking.
Am I on this card because I earned it, or because I was let in?
Who decided the stance was wrong? Is it so strange that I want to be seen standing straight?
Technique, according to whom? Who taught you that the standard is yours alone?
Strikes first, then what? Who decides whether that is enough?
A risk you did not choose is a question someone else answers. Who answers yours?
A stall is a question you do not want asked. Shall I ask it?
The people deserve a contest where both sides are heard. Will you hear me?
You think you are among the best. Who measured that, and who let you measure it?
You are proud of your {strength}. Is that pride earned, or handed to you?
I have wondered about your {strength}. Would you let me test it fairly?
Cool head: does that count for anything? Okay. Does calm make you right, or only quiet?
Does that land with you? Can we agree on that without someone talking over us?
Could I ask you a question about that? I would like an honest answer.
Who keeps the count? Who keeps the count? Can we agree on it first?
On the mat, when will you let me take a breath? Or will you keep talking over me?
Grounded or standing, who gets to decide the next move?
Will you face me? Will you let me finish a sentence?
Is that a proper answer? Is that one you believe, or one you are repeating?
Will you let the question stand? Will you, or will you talk over me again?
Does that land with you? Is that what you meant?
Can I accept that? Will you hold to it when the bell goes?
I will wrestle this match, and I will ask my questions in the ring.
Will you let me be patient? I want a fair start, and I will make sure I get one.
Whatever happens, will the people see what happened?
Is this finished? I do not think it is.
I have one question left, and you will answer it when the bell goes.
